description.value: Full-service RV resort in Fernie with 11 tent sites (some backing onto the Elk River), two flush washroom buildings with showers, and twelve loaner bikes for riding paved paths into town; open year-round with winter camping packages and a ski-hill shuttle.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and detailed. The amenities page confirms 11 tent sites, two washroom buildings with showers, potable water within 30 metres of tent sites plus a fill-up station, and 12 loaner townie bikes at no cost — all directly relevant to touring cyclists. A modular pump track was added in June 2024, further supporting a cycling-friendly profile. A minor postal code inconsistency exists on the website (V0B 1M5 in some footers vs. V0B 1M0 on the contact page and in OSM), flagged in concerns; all other contact details align.
concerns: Postal code inconsistency on website: several page footers show V0B 1M5 for the physical address while the contact page and OSM both show V0B 1M0. OSM value V0B 1M0 retained; recommend confirming correct postal code directly with the property.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established full-service camping resort with tent sites, showers, potable water, loaner bikes, and an on-site pump track — strong amenity profile for touring cyclists visiting Fernie.
enrichment_extras.notes: Twelve loaner townie bikes (8 with grocery baskets) available at no cost to registered guests — particularly useful for cycling tourists. Modular pump track added June 2024 is open to cyclists and all wheeled users.

wow_evidence: 12 loaner townie bikes at no cost... modular pump track was added in June 2024
